stem_book: Two equal masses m each are attached by a string. One mass lies at radial distance r from the centre of a horizontal turn-table which rotates with constant angular velocity ω = 2 rad s^(−1), while the other mass hangs from the string inside the turn-table's hollow spindle (see figure). The coefficient of static friction between the turn-table and the mass lying on it is μs = 0.8. The maximum and minimum values of r such that the mass lying on the turn-table does not slide are r_max and r_min respectively. Find the value of (r_max − r_min) in metre. (Take g = 10 m/s².)
key: 4 m (r max = 4.5 m, r min = 0.5 m)
reason: added g = 10 m/s² to the stem (with g = 9.8 the answer is 3.92, not an integer)
work: T = mg; mω²r = mg ± μmg ⇒ r = g(1 ± 0.8)/ω² = 4.5 m, 0.5 m ⇒ difference = 4 m
